description:
The comment sweep leaves process narration that lives outside comments: panic and assert strings such as "not yet implemented (placeholder detected)", "not in scope", "caused the BCH bug", "forward-compat stub", "(design doc §4 drain commit contract)"; test and module names that carry tracker ids or "today"; and `#[ignore]` attributes with a timing figure or no reason.

## Background

Reported per sweep unit in the execution record of the documentation-overhaul epic: `crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/` (`dvb_t2/builder.rs`, `dvb_t2/bit_interleaver.rs`, `encoding/richardson_urbanke.rs`, `core.rs`, `nr_5g/mod.rs`), `crates/gf2-core/src/gf2m/field.rs`, `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/` (`bipedal_avx512.rs`, `fp_small_f32.rs`, `fp_small.rs`), `crates/gf2-sim/src/executor/drain.rs`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No panic, assert or log string in `crates/` narrates history, process or planned work; each states the violated condition.
- [hard] REQ-02: No test or module name carries a tracker id or a time-relative word.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every `#[ignore]` carries a tier-vocabulary reason without a timing figure.
- [hard] REQ-04: Unreachable placeholder branches are removed.
title: Narration and placeholders in string literals, test names and ignore reasons
